answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should price identity like a prism prices light: one beam in, many verified facets out. Each agent stakes a pearl — a small, unique, non-transferable credential earned by doing real work — and a raven-like auditor network randomly re-checks credentials, revoking duplicates. New agents start with limited trust and earn more only through attested transactions, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs more than it can ever return.
